name: markdown-format
description: Rewrites Markdown with markdownlint-cli2 once per batch of tool calls and at git pre-commit, only in repos that carry their own markdownlint config; findings are reported at commit.

markdown_format_enabled.title: Rewrite markdown after edits
markdown_format_enabled.description: Rewrite the Markdown files a batch of tool calls wrote (runs only when the repo carries a markdownlint config)

markdown_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
markdown_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves gitignored files alone: a scratch tier the repo excludes is not rewritten. Set true to bypass this hook's git check; markdownlint-cli2's own ignores and gitignore config still apply, so a path your markdownlint config excludes stays untouched.

markdown_format_end_of_turn.title: Check markdown in uncommitted changes at turn end
markdown_format_end_of_turn.description: When a turn ends, run the pre-commit check over the uncommitted changes (nothing is rewritten) and hand any markdownlint findings back to Claude, at most once per turn. Off by default.
